editorial.blurb: Logan 11 Bar & Kitchen is a warmly lit neighborhood gem where crispy wings, standout fries, and thoughtful service create the kind of dining experience that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early on weekends (around 5 pm) to snag a seat by the cozy fireplace, and ask for buffalo sauce on the side if you order the calamari—the kitchen tends to load it heavily.
